theater: 頓巴斯與烏克蘭北東戰線

battle.name: 俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭
battle.theater: 頓巴斯與烏克蘭北東戰線
battle.brief: 2022年2月24日俄軍以空降、導彈與縱隊同時打開北、東、南三線，四月退出基輔方向。卡面1840年法式雷管步槍代表底火取代火燧後的射擊技術：槍枝在雨霧中可靠發火，射程拉長，密集隊形隨之瓦解；2022年秋冬的頓巴斯泥雪黑土，正是同一課題的現代版——分散陣地與反器材火力壓過人海。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 交戰雙方是俄羅斯聯邦與烏克蘭。俄方主力是聯邦武裝力量，西部軍區與南部軍區轄下的第1近衛坦克集團軍、第2、第3、第29、第36、第43、第49、第57集團軍，配屬第76、98空降師、第45別動旅與俄羅斯國民近衛軍（2022年由第4坦克師改編）投入北、東、南三個方向；黑海艦隊自塞瓦斯托波爾與刻赤出動，為陸戰提供縱深射擊，並以水雷與巡飛彈封鎖烏克蘭海軍。頓涅茨克人民共和國、盧甘斯克人民共和國的武裝與車臣部隊充當前線配合，瓦格納集團則以僱傭兵身份獨立參戰。烏克蘭由武裝部隊總司令部統一調度，轄下地面部隊、空降部隊、國民兵、國家邊境警衛隊與2021年起整編的國土防衛部隊，另有亞速團等志願部隊與徵召預備役；海軍以黑海艦隊與海上特種群配合水雷作戰。北約並未派地面部隊參戰，但自2022年起持續提供武器、訓練、情報與無人機援助；白俄羅斯提供基地與後勤協助，伊朗自2022年10月起供應見證系列遠程攻擊無人機。
countriesEn: The two sides in this war are the Russian Federation and Ukraine. On the Russian side the main effort was carried by the Russian Armed Forces: the 1st Guards Tank Army together with the 2nd, 3rd, 29th, 36th, 43rd, 49th and 57th Combined Arms Armies of the Western and Southern Military Districts, supported by the 76th and 98th Air Assault Divisions, the 45th Separate Spetsnaz Brigade and the Rosgvardia, whose 2nd Guards Tank Army was reorganised out of the old 4th Tank Division in 2022, were committed to the northern, eastern and southern axes. The Black Sea Fleet operated out of Sevastopol and Kerch, providing long-range gunfire in support of the land campaign and using naval mines and loitering munitions to blockade the Ukrainian Navy. The armed forces of the self-proclaimed Donetsk and Luhansk people's republics and Chechen detachments fought on the front line, while the Wagner Group took part as an independent mercenary formation. Ukraine was directed by the General Staff of the Armed Forces, with the Ground Forces, the Air Assault Forces, the National Guard, the State Border Guard Service and the Territorial Defence Forces reorganised from 2021, together with volunteer formations such as the Azov regiment and the mobilised reserve; the Ukrainian Navy fought with Black Sea Fleet elements and the Sea-Borne special group, using sea mines. NATO deployed no ground troops, but from 2022 onwards it delivered weapons, training, intelligence and drone support; Belarus provided basing and logistics assistance, and Iran began supplying Shahed-series long-range attack drones from October 2022.
people: 關鍵人物集中在兩層。俄方最高決策者是總統普京：2022年2月21日他以保護頓涅茨克與盧甘斯克兩共和國的名義承認其獨立，2月23日發表講話否定烏克蘭的主權地位，隨即下令進攻。國防部長紹伊古宣布去軍事化與去納粹化的要求，總參謀長格拉西莫夫負責作戰計劃，西部軍區司令久明、北方軍區司令朱尼切夫、南部軍區司令格魯莫夫陸續接掌指揮，2022年9月蘇羅夫金被任命為全軍總指揮。瓦格納首腦普里戈津以巴赫穆特方向的攻擊換取軍火與通行權，2023年6月曾率部進軍莫斯科兵變，8月空難身亡。車臣行政長官卡德羅夫以阿奇部隊參戰。烏方由總統澤連斯基主導政治，軍隊總司令先是扎盧日尼，2023年8月由瑟爾斯基接任，國防情報局局長布達諾夫策劃海上等特種行動；頓涅茨克民兵指揮官普希林與盧甘斯克民兵指揮官帕塞奇尼克自2014年起在前線作戰。2022年4月之後，烏克蘭以國土防衛與志願兵制度迅速擴軍，湧現出一批來自志願營與前線經驗的中校以下基層指揮官。
peopleEn: The decisive figures sit at two levels. On the Russian side the final decision belonged to President Vladimir Putin: on 21 February 2022 he recognised the independence of the Donetsk and Luhansk people's republics on the pretext of protecting them, on 23 February he spoke in terms that denied Ukraine's sovereignty, and he ordered the invasion the following day. Defence Minister Sergei Shoigu announced the demands of demilitarisation and denazification, General Staff chief Valery Gerasimov drew up the operational plan, and the theatre commanders changed repeatedly: Yevgeny Kumin, Nikolai Zhinichev and Vladimir Gromov led the early phases, and Sergei Surovikin was appointed overall commander in September 2022. Wagner chief Yevgeny Prigozhin bartered his offensives in the Bakhmut direction for ammunition and freedom of movement, marched on Moscow during the mutiny of June 2023, and died in an aircraft crash that August. Chechen head Ramzan Kadyrov committed the Kadyrovites units. On the Ukrainian side President Volodymyr Zelenskyy set the political direction, the army was led first by Commander-in-Chief Valerii Zaluzhnyi and from August 2023 by General Oleksandr Syrskyi, and the head of military intelligence HUR, Kyrylo Budanov, planned special operations such as Sea-Borne; the Donbas militia commanders Denys Pushilin and Leonid Pasechnik had been fighting on the front line since 2014. From April 2022 Ukraine expanded its army rapidly on a Territorial Defence and volunteer model, producing a new generation of battalion and regimental commanders, mostly lieutenant-colonels and below, whose experience came from the volunteer battalions and the front line.
kits: 卡面的1840年法式雷管步槍在2022年已是極舊的技術痕跡，但它留下的血脈幾乎撐住整個戰場。法國1840年製步槍是雷管系列的代表，底火取代火燧後槍枝可在雨霧中可靠發射；此後歐洲各國的栓動步槍，包括俄製莫辛-那伽1891式、蘇制SKS卡賓槍與AK-74、AK-74M，乃至烏克蘭接收的美制M16A4，雖然改用整發底火，本質都是雷管步槍的後裔。莫辛-那伽1891式（含1891/30狙擊型與91式）2022年仍大量配發俄羅斯志願兵、頓涅茨克與盧甘斯克民兵，也配給烏克蘭國土防衛部隊與後備部隊；SKS與AK-74系列構成烏軍前線步兵的主裝備，烏克蘭兵源的缺口主要靠這批老槍與外國新槍一起填補。西方援助方面，美國於2022年10月宣布交付兩千支M16A4步槍、六千具標槍反裝甲系統、四千套反坦克系統及數千具毒刺便攜防空導彈；英國提供挑戰者2主戰坦克與阿爾徹自行火砲，丹麥提供凱撒自行火砲，波蘭提供克雷自行步槍砲，捷克提供 vz.52步槍與利安自行火箭砲，北約的M142海馬斯與M270多管火箭炮自2022年6月起分批到貨。
kitsEn: The 1840 French percussion rifle on the card face was by 2022 a very old trace of technology, yet the line of descent it opened carries most of the battlefield. The French Model 1840 musket was the representative of the percussion series, and once the percussion cap replaced the flint the weapon could be fired reliably in rain and fog; every European bolt-action rifle that followed, including the Russian Mosin-Nagant 1891, the Soviet SKS carbine and the AK-74 and AK-74M, and even the American M16A4 that Ukraine received, is in substance a descendant of the percussion rifle, even though all of them use self-contained primers. The Mosin-Nagant 1891, in its 1891/30 sniper and Model 91 forms, was still issued in large numbers in 2022 to Russian volunteers, to the Donetsk and Luhansk militias, and to Ukrainian territorial defence and reserve formations; the SKS and AK-74 series made up the main infantry weapons of the Ukrainian line, and the gaps in Ukrainian manpower were filled with these old rifles and new foreign ones together. On the Western aid side, the United States announced in October 2022 the delivery of 2,000 M16A4 rifles, 6,000 Javelin anti-tank systems, 4,000 anti-tank systems and several thousand Stinger man-portable air-defence missiles. Britain supplied Challenger 2 main battle tanks and Archer self-propelled guns, Denmark supplied CAESAR self-propelled howitzers, Poland supplied Krab self-propelled howitzers, the Czech Republic supplied vz.52 rifles and the LION self-propelled rocket launcher, and NATO M142 HIMARS and M270 MLRS systems arrived in batches from June 2022.
tactics: 俄方2022年打法是三段式：東方行動以空降奪取霍斯托梅利、瓦西爾基夫、盧甘斯克北、切爾尼戈夫與蘇梅等機場，配合同期導彈與巡飛彈攻擊，企圖在數日內拿下基輔，結果在列存的堅固與未鋪好的城市戰中停滯，二月底至三月初被迫改為包圍，四月初完全退出基輔州。地面重點隨即轉向頓巴斯：烏軍以縱深塹壕、坑道與反坦克障礙構成多層防線，俄軍則以天山-S與向日葵自行火砲、BM-21冰雹火箭炮、TOS-1A噴射武器與伊斯坎德爾導彈打擊烏軍縱深，試圖用縱深火力與火力準備換取突破時間。2022年7月底海馬斯投入後，烏軍以精確打擊貫穿俄軍後方彈藥庫與指揮所，俄軍被迫把前線拉長、彈藥消耗拉高，同時大量使用突擊部隊消耗烏軍骨幹。烏軍的戰術重點是分散：連排分散，依托建築物與林帶，車組不集中，盡量避免在道路與林帶中被機械化火力一次掃空，同時以無人機巡邏與光電觀察替代人工偵察，用標槍與尼爾伏擊打擊裝甲集群。冬春黑土地帶泥濘、無夜視、燃料短缺與無人機偵察，使機械化推進效率驟降，戰役由閃擊退回成百公里長的消耗戰。
tacticsEn: The Russian plan of 2022 had three stages. Operation Vostok combined airborne seizure of the airfields at Hostomel, Vasylkiv, Luhansk Pivnichna, Chernihiv and Sumy with simultaneous missile and loitering munition strikes, aiming to take Kyiv within days; the attempt jammed against unexpected resistance and an unprepared urban battlefield, and by late February and early March it had been converted into a blockade, with the troops withdrawing from the Kyiv oblast altogether by the beginning of April. The ground effort then swung to the Donbas. Ukraine built layered defences of depth trenches, dugouts and anti-tank obstacles, while Russia relied on 2S19 Msta-S and 2S35 Koalitsiya self-propelled guns, BM-21 Grad rocket launchers, TOS-1A flamethrower systems and Iskander missiles against the Ukrainian rear areas, trying to buy breakthrough time with long-range fires and preparatory barrages. Once HIMARS entered service in late July 2022, Ukrainian precision strikes reached Russian ammunition depots and command posts behind the line; Russia responded by stretching the front, raising ammunition consumption and committing assault detachments to grind down Ukrainian cadre units. The Ukrainian tactical answer was dispersion: squads spread out, positions based on buildings and tree lines, tank crews kept apart, columns and forest tracks avoided so that they could not be wiped out in one pass by mechanised fire, with drone patrols and electro-optical observation replacing man-made reconnaissance and Javelin and NLAW ambushes hunting armoured groups. Mud in the black-earth belt in winter and spring, the absence of night vision, fuel shortages and constant drone surveillance cut the efficiency of mechanised advance, and the campaign slid back from blitzkrieg into a grinding war along a front hundreds of kilometres long.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。戰前俄方在烏克蘭邊境集結的兵力，美方2022年2月18日估計約十六萬九千至十九萬人，其中可地面機動作戰者約八萬，另有作戰飛機三千至四千架。烏克蘭常備武裝部隊與國民兵合計約十五至二十萬，至2022年底擴充至約三十萬；9月21日宣布的部分動員在四個月內徵召約三十萬人。第一階段結束時俄方宣稱控制烏克蘭約百分之二十的土地，多集中於頓涅茨克、盧甘斯克南部、扎波羅熱與赫爾松北岸；經9月27日公民投票與9月30日的兼併宣布後，四州全域被列入俄方版圖。烏方國防部2022年12月稱，十一個月內俄軍損失約三十萬人，約佔其戰前陸軍的三成。海上：4月17日莫斯科號巡洋艦在黑海觸雷沉沒，483名艦員全部陣亡，10月馬卡羅夫海軍元帥號巡擊艦被觸及重傷；西方援助方面，美國2022年10月宣布交付兩千支M16A4步槍、六千具標槍、四千套反坦克系統。時間線上，2月24日開打，4月初基輔方向收兵，5月20日馬里烏波爾陷落，7月1日北頓涅茨克被佔，9月4日烏軍在哈爾科夫反攻，10月初俄軍退出絕大部分哈爾科夫州，11月俄軍冬季攻勢投入約五百輛坦克，12月烏軍收復萊曼。
dataEn: The verifiable figures run roughly as follows. On the eve of the invasion the United States estimated on 18 February 2022 that Russia had massed between 169,000 and 190,000 personnel on the Ukrainian border, of whom about 80,000 were capable of ground manoeuvre, together with 3,000 to 4,000 combat aircraft. Ukraine's standing armed forces and National Guard together numbered roughly 150,000 to 200,000 and had grown to about 300,000 by the end of 2022; the partial mobilisation announced on 21 September drew in around 300,000 men within four months. By the end of the first phase Russia claimed to hold about twenty per cent of Ukraine's territory, concentrated in Donetsk, southern Luhansk, Zaporizhzhia and the northern shore of Kherson; after the 27 September referendums and the annexation declaration of 30 September the four oblasts in their entirety were folded into the Russian claim. Ukraine's Ministry of Defence stated in December 2022 that Russia had lost about 300,000 men in eleven months, close to thirty per cent of its pre-war army. At sea, on 17 April the guided-missile cruiser Moskva struck a mine in the Black Sea and sank with all 483 of her crew, and in October the frigate Admiral Makarov was badly damaged by a mine strike; on the aid side, the United States announced in October 2022 the delivery of 2,000 M16A4 rifles, 6,000 Javelins and 4,000 anti-tank systems. On the timeline: fighting began on 24 February, the Kyiv axis was wound up in early April, Mariupol fell on 20 May, Severodonetsk was taken on 1 July, Ukraine counter-attacked at Kharkiv on 4 September, Russian troops left most of the Kharkiv oblast in early October, the Russian winter offensive committed about five hundred tanks in November, and in December Ukrainian forces retook Lyman.
cause: 動因可分近因與遠因。近因是2014年2月烏克蘭變天、俄軍進駐克里米亞並兼併塞瓦斯托波爾，同年4月頓巴斯戰事爆發，烏俄在明斯克協議框架下維持低強度對抗；俄羅斯自2014年起以保護頓涅茨克居民為由扶植兩共和國，2018年通車的克里米亞大橋把克里米亞與本土連成一體。遠因是1991年蘇聯解體後的邊界與核武問題：1994年布達佩斯備忘錄之後，烏克蘭放棄核武器並加入不擴散核武器條約，卻未取得任何具約束力的安全承諾；北約1999年擴張、2008年又承諾烏克蘭終將加入，進一步加深俄方疑慮。2021年秋起，歐洲安全與合作組織的核查報告屢次記錄俄方在烏邊境集結大量部隊；2022年初，美國與北約公開評估俄軍可能在年內動武。2月21日普京宣布承認兩共和國，2月23日講話要求烏克蘭去軍事化與去納粹化，2月24日俄軍開火。在國際法上此役被認定為侵略：3月2日聯合國大會以141票贊成、5票反對、35票棄權通過第11號緊急決議，國際刑事法院亦於3月17日對普京發出逮捕令。
causeEn: The causes divide into immediate and remote. In the immediate term, the fall of the government in Kyiv in February 2014, the Russian deployment to Crimea and the annexation of Sevastopol, and the outbreak of fighting in the Donbas in April 2014 left Russia and Ukraine locked into low-intensity attrition under the Minsk agreements; from 2014 onward Moscow propped up the two self-proclaimed republics on the pretext of protecting the population of Donetsk, and the Crimean bridge, opened to traffic in 2018, tied the peninsula to the mainland. In the remote term lie the borders and the nuclear question left by the dissolution of the Soviet Union in 1991: after the 1994 Budapest Memorandum Ukraine gave up its nuclear arsenal and joined the Non-Proliferation Treaty without receiving any binding security guarantee, and the 1999 enlargement of NATO together with the 2008 declaration that Ukraine would eventually join deepened Moscow's sense of encirclement. From the autumn of 2021 OSCE inspection reports repeatedly recorded large Russian troop concentrations on the Ukrainian border, and in early 2022 the United States and NATO publicly assessed that Russia might move in the course of the year. On 21 February Putin recognised the two republics; on 23 February he demanded the demilitarisation and denazification of Ukraine; on 24 February Russian forces opened fire. In international law the war is treated as aggression: on 2 March the UN General Assembly adopted resolution ES-11/1 with 141 votes in favour, 5 against and 35 abstentions, and the International Criminal Court issued a warrant for Putin's arrest on 17 March.
impact: 戰爭最深的影響落在歐洲安全架構。北約東翼直接暴露，芬蘭於2023年4月4日、瑞典於2024年3月7日正式入盟；德國在2022年5月27日設立一千億歐元時代轉變特別基金並廢除憲法赤字上限，歐盟其後以歐洲安全工具等方式撥款，歐洲整體軍費結構被重寫。俄羅斯的戰時經濟被制裁與歐盟能源禁令壓制，天然氣出口管道北溪一號與二號在2022年9月26日被破壞；與此同時，烏克蘭的港口吞吐成為全球糧食價格的變數，7月22日簽訂的黑海糧食走廊協議一年內運出接近三千萬噸穀物，緩解了中東與非洲的糧價壓力。軍事技術層面的變化更為深遠：廉價一次性無人機與巡飛彈改寫了前沿的消耗結構，反裝甲小組與單兵掩體的重要性上升到戰車之上，而海馬斯這類中程火箭炮的加入，證明彈藥產能與精確打擊可以在沒有制空權的情況下改寫地面戰。制度層面，烏克蘭以國土防衛與志願兵制度重建了國防動員模型，北約盟國則被迫承認歐洲整體無法在短期內補足常備兵力，戰爭迫使多國把總動員從口號變成可操作的法律與後勤安排。
impactEn: The deepest effects fell on the European security architecture. The NATO eastern flank was suddenly exposed, Finland joined the alliance on 4 April 2023 and Sweden on 7 March 2024; on 27 May 2022 Germany created a one-hundred-billion-euro special fund for the Zeitenwende and lifted the constitutional deficit brake, and the European Union followed with the European Security Facility and other instruments, rewriting the whole European defence budget structure. Russia's wartime economy was squeezed by sanctions and the EU energy embargo, and the Nord Stream 1 and 2 gas pipelines were destroyed on 26 September 2022. At the same time Ukrainian port throughput became a variable in global food prices: the Black Sea Grain Initiative signed on 22 July moved close to thirty million tonnes of grain in its first year and eased pressure on prices in the Middle East and Africa. The change in military technology is even deeper. Cheap expendable drones and loitering munitions rewrote the cost structure of the front line, and the importance of anti-tank teams and individual fighting positions rose above that of the tank, while the arrival of a mid-range rocket system such as HIMARS proved that ammunition production and precision strike could reshape a ground war without air superiority. Institutionally, Ukraine rebuilt its model of military mobilisation on the Territorial Defence and volunteer system, while NATO members had to admit that Europe as a whole could not quickly make up its standing forces, and the war forced several states to turn general mobilisation from a slogan into operable law and logistics.
result: 結果可以分前期與長期兩層。前期：2022年2月24日展開的速戰速決目標在三日內落空，俄軍未能奪取基輔，縱深打擊與消耗戰取代了最初的突擊方案；俄軍在五個月內拿下北頓涅茨克、馬里烏波爾等要點與克里米亞以東的沿黑海走廊，並在9月27日以四州公民投票為基礎，於9月30日宣布兼併頓涅茨克、盧甘斯克、赫爾松、扎波羅熱四州，把軍事佔領轉成法律主張，聯合國大會隨後以壓倒多數不予承認。烏克蘭則守住國家存續與首都，並於9月4日發動哈爾科夫反攻，逐步收復盧甘斯克州西部與赫爾松州北部；戰線自2022年秋起大致凍結在頓巴斯一線，雙方以炮火與無人機消耗對方兵力，烏方2022年9月宣布部分動員、2023年推進和平談判。長期：截至2024年衝突仍在進行，條約與安全保證的討論成為外交主線，而這場戰爭留下的最大教訓，是火砲、步兵與無人機之間的成本比，已經不再有利於依賴兵力優勢的一方。
resultEn: The outcome divides into an early phase and a long one. In the early phase the attempt to impose a quick decision failed within three days: Russia did not take Kyiv, and deep strike plus attritional combat replaced the original plan of manoeuvre. Within five months Russian forces had seized Severodonetsk, Mariupol and other key points, together with the Black Sea shore east of Crimea, and on 27 September, on the basis of referendums in four oblasts, declared the annexation of Donetsk, Luhansk, Kherson and Zaporizhzhia on 30 September, converting military occupation into a legal claim that the UN General Assembly then declined to recognise by an overwhelming majority. Ukraine in turn preserved the continuity of the state and of the capital, and launched the Kharkiv counter-offensive on 4 September, gradually recovering western Luhansk and northern Kherson; from the autumn of 2022 the front was broadly frozen along the Donbas line, both sides wearing each other down with artillery and drones, while Ukraine declared a partial mobilisation in September 2022 and pushed peace talks in 2023. In the long run the conflict was still under way in 2024, with negotiations over a treaty and over security guarantees as the main diplomatic track, and the largest lesson of the war is that the cost ratio between artillery, infantry and drones no longer favours the side that relies on numerical superiority.
